stops.name: Promontorio del Caprione
stops.detail: In addition to the river area, the Caprione promontory is of great naturalistic and historical-cultural value, an ideal starting point for many excursions.

stops.name: Punta Bianca
stops.detail: Particularly interesting is the geological series of Punta Bianca, the southern extremity of the Caprione promontory.

stops.name: Val di Magra
stops.detail: The sea and the coast with highly attractive seaside villages and beaches give way to the Magra valley with its wetlands rich in biodiversity and inland to the green hills of the Vara valley.

stops.name: Alta Via dei Monti Liguri
stops.detail: In the Park area there are many hiking trails and it is crossed by the Alta Via dei Monti Liguri, the Sentiero Liguria and the Alta Via del Golfo.

stops.name: Bozi di Sarzana
stops.detail: But the park is not only a collection of unique landscapes, it is also a laboratory of "certified" conservation and environmental redevelopment projects that revolve around the wetland of the Bozi di Sarzana and the Montemarcello Botanical Garden.

stops.name: Piana di Marinella
stops.detail: In the Marinella plain there is also the cattle egret (Bubulcus ibis).
